at_risk.text: Which of our projects are in trouble right now, and why? Put a short answer in at-risk.md, with a table of every active project: project, RAG status (Red, Amber or Green) and the reason in a sentence.

budget_check.text: Finance wants a budget check. For each active project, give the approved budget, the actual spend to date from the finance export, the forecast at completion (actuals plus the remaining forecast in the tracker), and the variance against budget in dollars and as a percentage. Save it as budget check.xlsx.

decision_log.text: Build a decision log from the meeting notes, the project meetings and the steering committee but not the archive: one row per decision with the date, the project, the decision, and who made or approved it. Save it as decision log.xlsx.

one_on_one.text: I have a 1:1 with Tom Okafor tomorrow. Give me a one-page brief on everything on his plate: his open action items, the risks he owns, and his milestones in the next 30 days. Save it as Tom 1-1 prep.docx.

open_actions.text: Make me a spreadsheet of every action item from the last four weeks of meetings that is still open: who owns it, what it is, when it is due, which project, and which meeting it came from. Leave out anything that has been done since. Save it as open actions.xlsx.

raid_update.text: Update the RAID log with what has come up in meetings since it was last reviewed: add the new risks and close the ones that have been dealt with. Keep the same layout, and save it as RAID log 2026-11-02.xlsx so I still have the old one.

sponsor_reply.text: Draft a reply to Helen's email about Beacon (it is in email/). Answer her questions and keep it short. Save the draft as reply to Helen.md.

status_report.text: Write the fortnightly portfolio status report for the leadership team, covering what has happened since the last one (it is in status reports/). Give each active project a RAG status, and keep it to about a page.

steering_deck.text: Put together a short deck for the next steering committee, 6 to 8 slides: where the portfolio stands, one slide for each project that is at risk (what is wrong, the impact, and what we need the committee to decide), and a closing slide listing the decisions we are asking for. Save it as steering deck.pptx.
